title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #79 October 1985 Comic Book ISSN 0712-7774 - Dave Sim
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #79 comic book, published in October 1985 by Dave Sim, is a vintage collectible from the Copper Age era of US Comics. This issue features the character Cerebus within the comic series, showcasing Sim's unique storytelling and artistic style. With its classic comic book format and iconic imagery, this comic is a must-have for fans of Dave Sim's work and collectors of vintage comics.
